extraction_scope: Worker-6 bounded mechanism adjudication from abstract/results/figures/discussion and local XML/PDF/OA package.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: D/L diastereomeric analogs reduce eukaryotic membrane interaction while retaining stronger interaction with anionic prokaryotic membrane models.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: Peptide P analog series, especially D-substituted polar and non-polar face analogs
mechanism_claims.limitations: Mechanism is membrane-interaction/discrimination evidence from model membranes and discussion; no intracellular target is directly shown.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The selected L12D/L20D analog visibly damages bacterial cell surfaces in microscopy assays.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: L12D/L20D analog tested against S. aureus and P. aeruginosa
mechanism_claims.limitations: SEM supports membrane/cell-envelope damage for the tested analog and organisms; it does not quantify a molecular pore model.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Helicity and hydrophobicity changes from D-amino-acid substitution correlate with antimicrobial specificity and hemolysis changes.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Correlation evidence should not be promoted to a direct molecular target.

mechanism_cautions.note: The earlier automated nucleic-acid locator was a references-section false positive and is not retained as a mechanism claim.
